title: Kung Fu Boy Volume 33 功夫旋風兒 (Tong Li Comics, Traditional Chinese Edition)

descriptionText:
📚 Item Details:
Title: 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy)
Volume: 33
Author: 蛭田達也 (Tatsuya Hiruta)
Publisher: 東立出版社 (Tong Li Comics)
Language: Traditional Chinese
ISBN: 957-34-0189-4
Format: Paperback
Price printed on back: NT$65 / HK$25 / US$3
Condition: Very Good — minimal wear, cover colors remain vibrant. Binding tight, pages clean and crisp.
Edition: Official licensed Chinese edition (正式授權中文版 / 少年系列)
🖼️ Description:
This is Volume 33 of Kung Fu Boy (功夫旋風兒), the beloved martial arts manga by Tatsuya Hiruta (蛭田達也). Published by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社) in Taiwan, this edition presents the series in Traditional Chinese text for fans and collectors alike.
This volume’s cover features one of the series’ female characters in a swimsuit holding a red beach ball with the protagonist’s face — a fun and lighthearted design that contrasts with the manga’s usual high-energy martial arts scenes.
